title: Flauz product overlay (product.flauz.json)
description: Schema for the Flauz product overlay consumed by build/flauz/merge-product.mjs. The overlay is merged onto the upstream Code OSS product.json with null-deletes semantics: an explicit JSON null DELETES the key from the merged product (e.g. "defaultChatAgent": null removes the Copilot setup/entitlement wiring), plain objects merge recursively, arrays and scalars replace wholesale. v0 is permissive (additionalProperties: true) — unknown keys pass through the merge but are warned about on stderr by the merger because the pinned upstream tree (9bf9ae764da) has no IProductConfiguration consumer for them. TL1-002 grew the surface from the minimal identity set to the complete product shell: the rebrand family, the Copilot-residue cleanup, and the audited proposal grants. See build/flauz/README.md Appendix Lane F for the key-by-key rationale and build/flauz/RELEASE-SHELL.md for the release runbook.

nameShort.description: Product short name (IProductConfiguration.nameShort, src/vs/base/common/product.ts:105). Rebrands the IDE identity (window titles, about dialog). Must be "Flauz" — enforced by verify-product.mjs PS2.

nameLong.description: Product long name (IProductConfiguration.nameLong, src/vs/base/common/product.ts:106). Must be "Flauz" — enforced by verify-product.mjs PS2.

version.description: NOT a key of the shipped upstream product.json — upstream stamps version at build time from package.json (build/gulpfile.vscode.ts:176-205). Included in the overlay per the v0 work-order spec; flagged as DL-18 (version stamping conflict) — CI must reconcile this value with the build stamping (see RELEASE-SHELL.md §version stamping).

applicationName.description: Binary/executable name (product.ts; consumed by build/gulpfile.vscode.ts:187 for the linux desktopName and by the packaging pipelines). Rebrand: code-oss -> flauz.

dataFolderName.description: User data folder name (product.ts). Visible on every user's machine and separates Flauz user data from Code OSS's. Rebrand: .vscode-oss -> .flauz.

sharedDataFolderName.description: Shared user data folder name (product.ts). Rebrand: .vscode-oss-shared -> .flauz-shared.

win32MutexName.description: Windows single-instance mutex (product.ts). Functional identity: sharing the base value would make Flauz and Code OSS mutually exclusive on one machine. Rebrand: vscodeoss -> flauz.

win32DirName.description: Windows install directory name (product.ts). The base value literally names a Microsoft product. Rebrand: "Microsoft Code OSS" -> "Flauz".

win32NameVersion.description: Windows version-resource name (product.ts; shows in file properties / installer dialogs). Rebrand: "Microsoft Code OSS" -> "Flauz".

win32RegValueName.description: Windows uninstall registry value name (product.ts). Rebrand: CodeOSS -> Flauz.

win32AppUserModelId.description: Windows AppUserModelID for taskbar grouping/notifications (product.ts). Rebrand: Microsoft.CodeOSS -> Flauz.Flauz (publisher.product shape; no Flauz-owned company prefix exists yet — re-own when a Windows packaging lane lands).

win32ShellNameShort.description: Windows Start Menu shortcut name (product.ts). Rebrand: "C&ode - OSS" -> "Flauz".

win32TunnelServiceMutex.description: Windows tunnel-service single-instance mutex (product.ts). Same functional-identity class as win32MutexName. Rebrand: vscodeoss-tunnelservice -> flauz-tunnelservice.

win32TunnelMutex.description: Windows tunnel single-instance mutex (product.ts). Rebrand: vscodeoss-tunnel -> flauz-tunnel.

serverApplicationName.description: Remote-server binary name (product.ts). Rebrand: code-server-oss -> flauz-server.

tunnelApplicationName.description: Tunnel binary name (product.ts). Rebrand: code-tunnel-oss -> flauz-tunnel.

darwinBundleIdentifier.description: macOS bundle identifier (product.ts). Rebrand: com.visualstudio.code.oss -> flauz.flauz. A Flauz-controlled reverse-DNS domain must replace this when macOS signing/packaging lands (documented follow-up).

linuxDesktopName.description: Linux .desktop file basename (product.ts). Rebrand: com.visualstudio.CodeOSS -> flauz.flauz.

linuxIconName.description: Linux desktop icon name (product.ts). Rebrand: code-oss -> flauz.

urlProtocol.description: URL protocol handler scheme (product.ts). Rebrand: code-oss -> flauz (flauz:// links).

reportIssueUrl.description: Report-Issue target (product.ts; user-visible menu action). Rebrand: github.com/microsoft/vscode -> github.com/payswapdotorg/Flauz (the product repository per docs/FLAUZ-PROGRAM/SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md).

extensionEnabledApiProposals.description: Force-enables API proposals for extensions by "publisher.name" key (case-insensitive). The product list REPLACES the extension's own package.json declaration (src/vs/workbench/services/extensions/common/extensionsProposedApi.ts:80-102); an extension declaring proposals the product list lacks hits the runtime "WILL BE BROKEN" error at :91-97. This is the DL-4 pattern: enable proposed APIs for trusted Flauz built-ins via product overlay, zero promotion/fork. verify-product.mjs PS4 asserts every flauz-* manifest's declared proposals are covered EXACTLY, and that no undeclared grant exists beyond the documented flauz-agent default-participant pattern.

additionalProperties.description: List of API proposal names. Unknown names are silently dropped with a log warning by extensionsProposedApi.ts:46-52 — verify-product.mjs PS4 cross-checks them against src/vs/platform/extensions/common/extensionsApiProposals.ts so a typo cannot pass silently.

defaultChatAgent.description: The upstream Copilot default-agent product block (product.json:90-157; IDefaultChatAgent at src/vs/base/common/product.ts). In the Flauz overlay this is ALWAYS null, which the merger translates into a key DELETION: the merged product has no defaultChatAgent, which no-ops the whole Copilot setup/entitlement stack (src/vs/workbench/services/chat/common/chatEntitlementService.ts:458-460) so that the statically-contributed flauz.agent participant becomes the sole default chat agent. See canaries/default-agent-checklist.md (D1-D11) for every surface this touches.

builtInExtensionsEnabledWithAutoUpdates.description: Built-in extension ids that may auto-update (product.ts:258). MUST be an array (use [] to clear), NEVER null: the key is typed non-optional and iterated unguarded at src/vs/platform/extensionManagement/common/extensionsScannerService.ts:113 with no product-service defaults — a null-delete would crash the scanner (TL1-002 finding, encoded in merge-product.mjs validateOverlay). The base value ["GitHub.copilot-chat"] is inert Copilot residue (no copilot-chat ships; auto-update is quality-gated to stable at extensionsWorkbenchService.ts:343 and needs a gallery, which the base lacks) — the overlay clears it to [].

trustedExtensionAuthAccess.description: Auth-provider trust grants (product.ts:189): providerId -> list of extension ids allowed provider access without prompting. The overlay surgically null-deletes the github/github-enterprise entries that granted GitHub.copilot-chat (inert without a gallery or a shipped copilot-chat); the microsoft -> vscode.github-authentication grant is functional in-tree wiring and stays. All consumers are guarded (authenticationAccessService.ts:51-59, chatLanguageModelActions.ts:78-79), so nested null-deletes are safe.

additionalProperties.description: null deletes the provider's grant list from the merged product; an array replaces it wholesale.
